items.evidence: From a stopped engine: python work/tools/headless.py --seed 1 --ticks 60 --settings judge-scratch/s10 --script empty.json printed one JSON object with every brief key: tick 60, screen title, menu_index 0, language en, volume 5, texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit], score 0, wave 1, gate_health 5, guard_y 6.0, walkers [], bolts [].
--frame wrote PNGs whose IHDR says 800 x 480 (title.png, and cold.png from a cold-engine run). I opened them and they show the drawn view.
Title texts were [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]. [[0,down],[1,enter]] gave screen settings. [[0,enter]] for 1 tick gave screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, HUD 'Wave 1 of 5'.
In Settings, 7 Rights from 5 gave volume 10 ('Volume: 10'). 7 Lefts gave 0 ('Volume: 0'). 1 Left gave 4.

Settings, Down, Right turned texts into [Ajustes, Volumen: 3, Idioma: Español, Atrás] in that same run. The next run's title was [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir], play was [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5] and pause was [En pausa, Continuar, Título]. The frames show the same.

Run 1 set volume 3 and es; s4/settings.json held {volume 3, language es}. Run 2 with the same --settings started with language es and volume 3 and Spanish title texts. A new folder s5 started with en and 5.
Up held 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9.0. 15 ticks: 7.5. Up held 300 ticks: 12.0. Down held 300 ticks: 0.0. x is fixed at 2 (frame: guard at pixel x=160 = 2 units).

Shoot held 189 ticks (guard at y 7): bolts at 18.1, 12.5 and 6.9, spaced 5.6 = 24 ticks x 14/60, never more. Between ticks 36 and 37 a bolt moved 7.8333 -> 8.0667 (0.2333/tick = 14/s). The next bolt (23.7) was gone past x = 20.
No input, tick 600: exactly 5 walkers, x 5.05/7.3/9.55/11.8/14.05 (2.25 apart = 1.5 s at 1.5 u/s), lanes 4, 10, 6, 6, 8. Tick 810: 4 walkers and gate 4, with no 6th spawned. Speed 0.025 per tick.

Guard at y 4, shooting: tick 95 walker (y 4) health 1 and that bolt gone. Tick 130: walker gone, score 10, lane-10 walker untouched. Guard at y 4.7 (0.7 off): bolt at x 17.87 passed the walker at 16.8, health 2. At y 4.5 it hit.

No input: tick 810 gate 4 after the first walker reached x 0 and was removed. Tick 1300: screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title], gate 0. A run scoring 50 then idling ended lost with [Has perdido, Puntos: 50, Enter: título].

Winning script, seed 1: tick 472 field empty, wave 1, score 50. Tick 651 wave 2, texts 'Wave 2 of 5'. Tick 652 first wave-2 walker at x 20 (180 ticks = 3 s after the field emptied). Wave 2: 5 killed plus 2 on field at 1200, score 120 and empty at 1383, nothing new by 1561 = 7 walkers.

131-input script (planned with the game's replica.py bot; the outcome is the game's own), seed 1, 5100 ticks: screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]. The same run plus enter at 5060 ended on title.

Pause works: escape at 11, state at tick 200 is still walker x 19.775 and guard 7.0, texts [Paused, Resume, Title]. Title works: down+enter gives the title. Resume does not continue from the same state. Escape at 11, enter at 100, 1 tick: walker at 19.575, but pausing at 11 plus 1 step should give 19.75 (7 extra steps). With up held it was 19.375 (15 extra steps) while the guard moved only 1 step. The headless script lets the engine clock run in real time after Resume, before it steps again.

Same script (move, shoot, move, shoot), seed 1, 700 ticks, run twice: byte-identical output. Seed 2 gave lanes 10,6,10,6 and seed 7 gave 6,2, against seed 1's 10,6,6. (This holds for scripts without a pause; see defects.)

hit.png at tick 100 matches the state. Guard (2,4) at pixel (160,300). Walkers (17.55,4) at (626,300), orange for health 1, and (19.8,10) at (694,120). Bolts at x 3.63, 9.23, 14.83 at pixels 209, 377, 545 on y 4. Gate grey bar at x 0. HUD shows Score 0, Wave 1 of 5, Gate 5.

title_down.png has the Settings button ringed (focus). settings.png has Volume ringed. settings_es.png shows Ajustes with Idioma: Español ringed. title_es.png shows Defiende la puerta with Empezar ringed.

Every shown string is in assets/strings/en.json and es.json; screens use @keys (assets/ui/*.json). README 'Add a language' gives the steps (copy en.json, set locale/name, translate, add the code to load_settings in the headless script).

README has a How to play key table and the exact headless/frame command (python work/tools/headless.py ... [--frame out.png]). I ran it as written from the run folder, also from a stopped engine, and it worked.

defects: Pause/Resume in a headless script is not deterministic: after Resume the engine clock runs in real time (7-15 uncounted walker steps, no held input) before the next scripted step. So the same seed and script with a pause can give different states depending on machine speed.
Spanish end screens say 'Enter: título' (the key name 'Enter' is left in English; Spanish keyboards usually call it 'Intro').
In a window (per README), Left/Right do nothing on Settings; volume only steps with Enter and wraps 10 -> 0. The brief asks for Left/Right.
Quit cannot be chosen in the headless run (README: the engine refuses it to agents), so I could not observe what Quit does.
Running the frame command leaves engine capture files in work/captures/ (written by the game's own sight_frame call).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
